verses.geez: ወእደ፡ ተናገረ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ተሰጥወ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

translations.lxx: Then Job answered and said,
translations.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
translations.ron: Atunci Iov a răspuns şi a zis:
translations.grk: Ὑπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὼβ, λέγει,

verses.geez: አማን፡ አአምር፡ ከመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወእፎ፡ ይከውን፡ ጻድቅ፡ ንጹሐ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: I know of a truth that it is so: for how shall a mortal man be just before the Lord?

translations.lxx: I know of a truth that it is so: for how shall a mortal man be just before the Lord?
translations.kjv: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
translations.ron: "Ştiu bine că aşa este; căci cum ar putea un om să fie drept înaintea lui Dumnezeu?
translations.grk: Ἐπʼ ἀληθείας οἶδα, ὅτι οὕτως ἐστί· πῶς γὰρ ἔσται δίκαιος βροτὸς παρὰ Κυρίῳ;

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይትዋሣእ፡ ኢይሠጠዎ፡ አሐተ፡ ቃለ፡ እምእልፍ።
verses.translation: For if he would enter into judgment with him, God would not hearken to him, so that he should answer to one of his charges of a thousand.

translations.lxx: For if he would enter into judgment with him, God would not hearken to him, so that he should answer to one of his charges of a thousand.
translations.kjv: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
translations.ron: Dacă ar fi să se certe cu El, din o mie de lucruri n-ar putea să-I răspundă nici la unul singur.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν γὰρ βούληται κριθῆναι αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ ὑπακούσῃ αὐτῷ, ἵνα μὴ ἀντείπῃ πρὸς ἕνα λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐκ χιλίων.

verses.geez: ጠቢበ፡ ምክር፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዓቢየ፡ ኃይል፡ መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ እኩየ፡ ከዊኖ፡ ዘቆመ፡ ቅድሜሁ።
verses.translation: For he is wise in mind, and mighty, and great: who has hardened himself against him and endured?

translations.lxx: For he is wise in mind, and mighty, and great: who has hardened himself against him and endured?
translations.kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
translations.ron: A Lui este înţelepciunea şi atotputernicia; cine ar putea să-I stea împotrivă şi să rămână teafăr?
translations.grk: Σοφὸς γάρ ἐστι διανοίᾳ, κραταιός τε καὶ μέγας· τίς σκληρὸς γενόμενος ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὑπέμεινεν;

verses.geez: ዘያንቀለቅሎሙ፡ ለአድባር፡ ወኢይሬእይዎ፡ ወይገፈትዖሙ፡ በመዓቱ።
verses.translation: Who wears out the mountains, and men know it not: who overturns them in anger.

translations.lxx: Who wears out the mountains, and men know it not: who overturns them in anger.
translations.kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
translations.ron: El mişcă munţii din loc fără ca ei să prindă de veste că El i-a răsturnat în mânia Lui.
translations.grk: Ὁ παλαιῶν ὄρη καὶ οὐκ οἴδασιν, ὁ καταστρέφων αὐτὰ ὀργῇ·

verses.geez: ወያድለቀልቃ፡ ለምድር፡ እመሠረታቲሃ።
verses.translation: Who shakes the earth under heaven from its foundations, and its pillars totter.

translations.lxx: Who shakes the earth under heaven from its foundations, and its pillars totter.
translations.kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
translations.ron: El zguduie pământul din temelia lui, aşa încât stâlpii lui se clatină.
translations.grk: Ὁ σείων τὴν ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν ἐκ θεμελίων, οἱ δὲ στύλοι αὐτῆς σαλεύονται·

verses.geez: ወለሰማይ፡ የሀውኮን፡ ለአዕማዲሃ፡ ወያጸልሞሙ፡ ለከዋ፡ ክብቲሃ።
verses.translation: Who commands the sun, and it rises not; and he seals up the stars.

translations.lxx: Who commands the sun, and it rises not; and he seals up the stars.
translations.kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
translations.ron: El porunceşte soarelui şi soarele nu se mai ridică. El pune pecetea Lui asupra stelelor.
translations.grk: Ὁ λέγων τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνατέλλει, κατὰ δὲ ἄστρων κατασφραγίζει·

verses.geez: ዘየሐውር፡ መልዕልተ፡ ባሕር፡ ከመ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወሰፍሖ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ባሕቲቱ።
verses.translation: Who alone has stretched out the heavens, and walks on the sea as on firm ground.

translations.lxx: Who alone has stretched out the heavens, and walks on the sea as on firm ground.
translations.kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
translations.ron: El singur este Cel ce întinde cerurile şi umblă pe valurile mării.
translations.grk: Ὁ τανύσας τὸν οὐρανὸν μόνος, καὶ περιπατῶν ὡς ἐπʼ ἐδάφους ἐπὶ θαλάσσης·

verses.geez: ዘይብላ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ኢትሥርቂ፡ ወገጸ፡ ከዋክብት፡ የኃትም፡ ዘገብሮ፡ ለትርያ፡ ወአስጋብኦ፡ ወለደብርንሂ፡ ወይኌል፡ ቆሙ፡ ለከዋክብተ፡ ጽባሕ።
verses.translation: Who makes Pleias, and Hesperus, and Arcturus, and the chambers of the south.

translations.lxx: Who makes Pleias, and Hesperus, and Arcturus, and the chambers of the south.
translations.kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
translations.ron: El a zidit Carul mare, Raliţa, Pleiadele şi cămările stelelor de miazăzi.
translations.grk: Ὁ ποιῶν Πλειάδα καὶ Ἕσπερον καὶ Ἀρκτοῦρον, καὶ ταμεῖα Νότου·

verses.geez: ዘይገብር፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወያስተጋብእ፡ ወይሬኢ፡ ወይኌልቆሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ዓቢያተ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቁ።
verses.translation: Who does great and unsearchable things; glorious also and excellent things, innumerable.

translations.lxx: Who does great and unsearchable things; glorious also and excellent things, innumerable.
translations.kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
translations.ron: El a făcut lucruri mari şi nepătrunse şi minuni fără de număr.
translations.grk: Ὁ ποιῶν μεγάλα καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστα, ἔνδοξά τε καὶ ἐξαίσια, ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός.

verses.geez: እመኒ፡ ተዓደወኒ፡ ኢይሬእዮ፡ እመኒ፡ ኃለፈ፡ ኢየአምሮ።
verses.translation: If ever he should go beyond me, I shall not see him: if he should pass by me, neither thus have I known it.

translations.lxx: If ever he should go beyond me, I shall not see him: if he should pass by me, neither thus have I known it.
translations.kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
translations.ron: Iată, dacă trece pe lângă mine, eu nu-L văd, şi dacă se strecoară, eu nu-I prind de veste.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ὑπερβῇ με, οὐ μὴ ἴδω· ἐὰν παρέλθῃ με, οὐδʼ ὡς ἔγνων.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ አእተተ፡ ውእቱ፡ መኑ፡ ያገብእ፡ ወመኑ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ምንተ፡ ገበርከ።
verses.translation: If he would take away, who shall turn him back? or who shall say to him, What hast thou done?

translations.lxx: If he would take away, who shall turn him back? or who shall say to him, What hast thou done?
translations.kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
translations.ron: Dacă ia şi ridică, cine va putea să-L oprească şi cine-I va zice: Ce ai făcut?
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἀπαλλάξῃ, τίς ἀποστρέψει; ἢ τίς ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ, τί ἐποίησας;

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢተመይጠ፡ እመቅሠፍትየ፡ ወእምኔሁ፡ ተቀጽዑ፡ አናብርት፡ ዘመትሕተ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: For if he has turned away his anger, the whales under heaven have stooped under him.

translations.lxx: For if he has turned away his anger, the whales under heaven have stooped under him.
translations.kjv: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
translations.ron: Dumnezeu nu-şi înfrânează mânia Sa şi sub El se încovoaie toţi slujitorii mândriei.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς γὰρ ἀπέστραπται ὀργὴν, ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐκάμφθησαν κήτη τὰ ὑπʼ οὐρανόν

verses.geez: ወእፎኬ፡ ይሰምዓኒ፡ ቃልየ፡ ወይፌከሮ።
verses.translation: Oh then that he would hearken to me, or judge my cause.

translations.lxx: Oh then that he would hearken to me, or judge my cause.
translations.kjv: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
translations.ron: Şi eu atunci cum o să-I răspund şi ce cuvinte o să aleg?
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δέ μου ὑπακούσεται, ἤ διακρίνει τὰ ῥήματά μου.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ጸዋዕኩ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወኢሰምዓኒ፡ እስእል፡ ፍትሐ፡ ዚአሁ።
verses.translation: For though I be righteous, he will not hearken to me: I will intreat his judgment.

translations.lxx: For though I be righteous, he will not hearken to me: I will intreat his judgment.
translations.kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
translations.ron: Chiar dacă aş avea dreptate, nu-I voi răspunde, ci mă voi ruga judecătorului.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν γὰρ ὦ δίκαιος, οὐκ εἰσακούσεταί μου, τοῦ κρίματος αὐτοῦ δεηθήσομαι·

verses.geez: እመኒ፡ ጸዋዕኩ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወአውሥአኒ፡ ኢየአምን፡ ከመ፡ ሰምዓኒ።
verses.translation: And if I should call and he should not hearken, I cannot believe that he has listened to my voice.

translations.lxx: And if I should call and he should not hearken, I cannot believe that he has listened to my voice.
translations.kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
translations.ron: Chiar dacă m-ar asculta, când Îl chem, tot n-aş putea să cred că ascultă glasul meu,
translations.grk: Ἐάν τε καλέσω καὶ μὴ ὑπακούσῃ, οὐ πιστεύω ὅτι εἰσακήκοέ μου τῆς φωνῆς.

verses.geez: ዓውሎሁ፡ ይቀጠቅጠኒ፡ ውብዙኅ፡ አቊሰለኒ፡ በከንቱ።
verses.translation: Let him not crush me with a dark storm: but he has made my bruises many without cause.

translations.lxx: Let him not crush me with a dark storm: but he has made my bruises many without cause.
translations.kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
translations.ron: Căci El mă sfărâmă ca sub furtună şi înmulţeşte fără cuvânt rănile mele.
translations.grk: Μὴ γνόφῳ με ἐκτρίψῃ· πολλὰ δέ μου τὰ συντρίμματα πεποίηκε διακενῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢኀደገኒ፡ ከመ፡ አዕርፍ፡ ወአጽገበኒ፡ ኅምዘ።
verses.translation: For he suffers me not to take breath, but he has filled me with bitterness.

translations.lxx: For he suffers me not to take breath, but he has filled me with bitterness.
translations.kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
translations.ron: El nu-mi dă răgaz să răsuflu şi mă adapă cu amărăciune.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐᾷ γάρ με ἀναπνεῦσαι· ἐνέπλησε δέ με πικρίας,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ይእኅዝ፡ ወመኑ፡ ይትቃወሞ፡ ለኵነኔሁ፡ እመኒ፡ አፉየ፡ ዓመፀ፡ እምጽድቅ፡ ወእመሂ፡ አሕዐፀፅኩ፡ እምጽድቅ፡ ዕፁብ፡ ይርከበኒ።
verses.translation: For indeed he is strong in power: who then shall resist his judgment?

translations.lxx: For indeed he is strong in power: who then shall resist his judgment?
translations.kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
translations.ron: Dacă este vorba de putere, El este Cel puternic. Dacă este vorba de judecată, cine mă va apăra?
translations.grk: ὅτι μὲν γὰρ ἰσχύει κράτει· τίς οὖν κρίματι αὐτοῦ ἀντιστήσεται;

verses.geez: ወንጹሕ፡ አነ፡ ወኢየአምር፡ ነፍስየ፡ ወዳዕሙ፡ ጠፍአት፡ ሕይወትየ።
verses.translation: For though I should seem righteous, my mouth will be profane: and though I should seem blameless, I shall be proved perverse.

translations.lxx: For though I should seem righteous, my mouth will be profane: and though I should seem blameless, I shall be proved perverse.
translations.kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
translations.ron: Oricâtă dreptate aş avea, gura mea mă va osândi şi dacă sunt fără prihană ea mă scoate vinovat.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν γὰρ ὦ δίκαιος, τὸ στόμα μου ἀσεβήσει· ἐάν τε ᾧ ἄμεμπτος, σκολιὸς ἀποβήσομαι.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ እቤ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወኃያል፡ ይፌኑ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ እስመ፡ አኩይ፡ ሞቶሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ወይስሕቅዎሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወይገብኡ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ኃጥአን፡ ወይከድንዋ፡ ገጸ፡ መደልዋን፡ ወአነ፡ ምንተኑ፡ አነ።
verses.translation: For even if I have sinned, I know it not in my soul: but my life is taken away.

translations.lxx: For even if I have sinned, I know it not in my soul: but my life is taken away.
translations.kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
translations.ron: Sunt oare desăvârşit? Eu singur nu mă cunosc pe mine şi viaţa mea o dispreţuiesc.
translations.grk: Εἴτε γὰρ ἠσέβησα, οὐκ οἶδα τῇ ψυχῇ, πλὴν ἀφαιρεῖταί μου ἡ ζωή.

verses.geez: ወሕይወትየኒ፡ ትቀልል፡ እምረዊዐ፡ እለ፡ እምሰጡ፡ ወኢይረክቦሙ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: Wherefore I said, Wrath slays the great and mighty man.

translations.lxx: Wherefore I said, Wrath slays the great and mighty man.
translations.kjv: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea am zis: Tot una este! El nimiceşte pe cel desăvârşit şi pe cel viclean.
translations.grk: Διὸ εἶπον, μέγαν καὶ δυνάστην ἀπολλύει ὀργή,

verses.geez: ወእመኒቦ፡ ሐመር፡ አሠረ፡ ፍኖቱ፡ ኢይትአመር፡ አው፡ ንስር፡ ዘይሠርር፡ ወየኃሥሥ፡ ዘይበልዕ።
verses.translation: For the worthless die, but the righteous are laughed to scorn.

translations.lxx: For the worthless die, but the righteous are laughed to scorn.
translations.kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
translations.ron: Dacă o nenorocire aduce moartea deodată, ce-I pasă Lui de deznădejdea celor fără de vină?
translations.grk: ὅτι φαῦλοι ἐν θανάτῳ ἐξαισίῳ, ἀλλὰ δίκαιοι καταγελῶνται,

verses.geez: እመሂ፡ ነበብኩ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይበቊዕ፡ ወወድቀ፡ ገጽየ፡ በገዓር፡ ወአንቀልቀለ፡ ኵሉ፡ መለያልይየ፡ አእመርኩ፡ እንከሰ፡ ከመ፡ ኢየኃድገኒ፡ ከመዝ።
verses.translation: For they are delivered into the hands of the unrighteous man: he covers the faces of the judges of the earth: but if it be not he, who is it?

translations.lxx: For they are delivered into the hands of the unrighteous man: he covers the faces of the judges of the earth: but if it be not he, who is it?
translations.kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
translations.ron: Dacă o ţară a încăput pe mâna unui om viclean, El acoperă faţa judecătorilor Săi. Şi dacă nu El, cine atunci?
translations.grk: παραδέδονται γὰρ εἰς χεῖρας ἀσεβοῦς, πρόσωπα κριτῶν αὐτῆς συγκαλύπτει· εἰ δὲ μὴ αὐτός ἐστι, τίς ἐστιν;

verses.geez: እመሰኬ፡ ኃጥአ፡ አነ፡ ለምንት፡ ኢሞትኩ።
verses.translation: But my life is swifter than a post: my days have fled away, and they knew it not.

translations.lxx: But my life is swifter than a post: my days have fled away, and they knew it not.
translations.kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
translations.ron: Zilele mele sunt mai grabnice decât un aducător de veşti şi au fugit fără să vadă fericirea.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ βίος μου ἐστὶν ἐλαφρότερος δρομέως· ἀπέδρασαν, καὶ οὐκ εἴδοσαν.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ተሐፀብኩ፡ ወነጻሕኩ፡ ከመ፡ በረድ፡ ወአንጻሕኩ፡ እደውየ፡ በሕቁ።
verses.translation: Or again, is there a trace of their path left by ships? or is there one of the flying eagle as it seeks its prey?

translations.lxx: Or again, is there a trace of their path left by ships? or is there one of the flying eagle as it seeks its prey?
translations.kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
translations.ron: S-au strecurat ca nişte bărci de papură, ca un vultur care se năpusteşte asupra prăzii sale.
translations.grk: Ἢ καὶ ἐστι ναυσὶν ἴχνος ὁδοῦ, ἢ ἀετοῦ πετομένου ζητοῦντος βοράν;

verses.geez: ትጠምዓኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስሕት፡ ወታስቈርረኒ፡ ልብስየ።
verses.translation: And if I should say, I will forget to speak, I will bow down my face and groan;

translations.lxx: And if I should say, I will forget to speak, I will bow down my face and groan;
translations.kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
translations.ron: Dacă zic: Vreau să-mi uit suferinţa, să-mi schimb înfăţişarea şi să fiu voios,
translations.grk: Ἐάν τε γὰρ εἶπω, ἐπιλήσομαι λαλῶν, συγκύψας τῷ προσώπῳ στενάξω·

verses.geez: ሶቦሁ፡ ሰብአ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይትዋቀሠኒ፡ እምሖርነ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓውደ።
verses.translation: I quake in all my limbs, for I know that thou wilt not leave me alone as innocent.

translations.lxx: I quake in all my limbs, for I know that thou wilt not leave me alone as innocent.
translations.kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
translations.ron: Sunt năpădit de teama chinurilor mele, ştiind bine că Tu nu mă vei scoate nevinovat.
translations.grk: Σείομαι πᾶσι τοῖς μέλεσιν, οἴδα γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἀθῶόν με ἐάσεις.

verses.geez: ወዕበሁ፡ ቦ፡ ኅሩይ፡ ዘይፈትሕ፡ ለነ፡ ወያጸምእ፡ ማእከለ፡ ክልኤነ፡ እምተአተተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ በትር፡ እምኔየ።
verses.translation: But since I am ungodly, why have I not died?

translations.lxx: But since I am ungodly, why have I not died?
translations.kjv: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
translations.ron: Dacă sunt vinovat, de ce să mă mai trudesc zadarnic?
translations.grk: Ἐπειδὴ δέ εἰμι ἀσεβὴς, διὰ τί οὐκ ἀπέθανον;

verses.geez: ወእምኢፀብዓኒ፡ ግርማሁ፡ እትናገሮ፡ ወኢይሬእዮ።
verses.translation: For if I should wash myself with snow, and purge myself with pure hands,

translations.lxx: For if I should wash myself with snow, and purge myself with pure hands,
translations.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
translations.ron: Dacă m-aş spăla cu zăpadă şi mi-aş curăţi mâinile cu leşie,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν γὰρ ἀπολούσωμαι χιόνι, καὶ ἀποκαθάρωμαι χερσὶ καθαραῖς,

verses.geez: ወእነግር፡ እንከሰ፡ ወኢይፈርህ።
verses.translation: thou hadst thoroughly plunged me in filth, and my garment had abhorred me.

translations.lxx: thou hadst thoroughly plunged me in filth, and my garment had abhorred me.
translations.kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
translations.ron: Atunci Tu tot m-ai cufunda în noroi, încât şi veşmintele mele s-ar scârbi de mine.
translations.grk: ἱκανῶς ἐν ῥύπῳ με ἔβαψας, ἐβδελύξατο δέ με ἡ στολή.
